question: How many customers are from India?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'India';

question: List all products with fewer than 30 units in stock
reference_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 30;

question: Which customer has placed the highest number of orders?
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the mean total amount spent per order?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS order_totals;

question: Which product category generated the highest revenue from customers in India?
reference_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE c.country = 'India' GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.category_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
